scope.description: April–May 2014 chain data, all nonzero amount buckets. These frozen experiments are separate from the live collector and do not establish results for modern Monero.

experiments.title: Output origins are retrievable
experiments.finding: Actual ages ranged from 15 to 41,150 blocks in the selected contexts, yet all three legacy gamma features were constant. The audit exposed a feature limitation and usable origin metadata.
experiments.limitation: A fixed 40-output sample and one unauthenticated RPC endpoint do not establish population coverage or any model improvement. The v1 run did not fingerprint WAL state.

experiments.title: Four feature columns are constant
experiments.finding: All 24 feature columns were audited. Four complete columns were constant and four pairs were exactly equal in the sample. All 342,720 feature values were finite.
experiments.limitation: The stratified legacy sample is not population-weighted. Constants and duplicates do not demonstrate a gain from removing features; within-ring context features can still carry useful interactions.

experiments.title: Minimum reuse leads this comparison
experiments.finding: Minimum original-output reuse reached 82.31% expected agreement with current stored deterministic labels; the highest-index rule reached 78.45%. Tied choices receive fractional credit.
experiments.limitation: This is selective retrospective agreement, not prediction accuracy. Full-snapshot reuse includes later references; historical label availability and performance on unresolved rings remain unknown.

baseline_comparison.tie_method: 1/k expected correct if the current label is among k equally preferred candidates; zero otherwise; no index tiebreak.
baseline_comparison.interpretation: All four rules use the same 12,076 current deterministic multi-member rings and original candidates. Related rings are not independent; chronological quartiles are descriptive, not temporal test splits. These figures establish no address ownership, forward accuracy, or ML gain.

theoretical_conclusions.title: Test simpler feature sets on the same held-out rings
theoretical_conclusions.statement: Constant and duplicate columns justify a controlled ablation. They do not show that removing columns improves generalization, speed, or memory. Fit feature masks on training folds and preserve paired results, including a negative outcome.

theoretical_conclusions.title: Use origin metadata through a versioned feature experiment
theoretical_conclusions.statement: The origin audit motivates replacing relative-position proxies with validated creation metadata. The effect still needs a frozen comparison with missing-origin flags and protocol-appropriate assumptions. No performance benefit has been measured.

theoretical_conclusions.title: Recheck reuse using only prediction-time information
theoretical_conclusions.statement: Minimum reuse is a useful baseline to challenge in this historical population. Its lead may depend on later graph observations and which rings the analyzer could resolve. Prediction-time snapshots are needed before drawing a forward-performance conclusion.

theoretical_conclusions.title: Output relationships do not identify wallets or people
theoretical_conclusions.statement: Shared ring membership, candidate selections, and agreement with stored labels describe outputs and evidence. None of these completed experiments measures common wallet ownership, recovers receiving addresses, or identifies a person. Grouping claims need separately controlled labels and false-merge evaluation.

next_priorities.title: Run a paired feature ablation
next_priorities.why: Compare the unchanged scorer, constant/duplicate masks, and simple rules on the same frozen eligible test rings. Preserve sample counts, runtime, score changes, and negative results.

next_priorities.title: Freeze prediction-time reuse and label availability
next_priorities.why: Separate the signal available at prediction time from information added later. Current full-snapshot agreement cannot answer that question.

next_priorities.title: Evaluate versioned origin-age features
next_priorities.why: Validate joins and missingness first, then compare origin-age features with the existing proxy under the same independent evaluation boundary.

next_priorities.title: Expand coverage to independently validated later cohorts
next_priorities.why: The completed audits contain no amount-zero data. Audit later protocol eras before transferring historical feature or baseline conclusions.
